name: Violet Haze: all units become distant; curse placed on target champion's lineage
notes: Violet Haze is UMBRA (advanced element), so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real UMBRA champion (Tristan, Shadowdancer) to unlock element access -- the same pattern used elsewhere in this file for other UMBRA cards. A Dungeon Guide is seeded onto the field alongside the champion to confirm 'all units you control' isn't limited to the champion. Playing it (2-reserve) queues the usual reserve-payment MZCHOOSE=myHand decision (2 reps), then an unrelated optional MZMAYCHOOSE (declined with PASS), then the target-champion MZCHOOSE, before both units gain DISTANT and the card is placed into the champion's Subcards (lineage) rather than the graveyard.

rulesClauses: All units you control become distant, then put Violet Haze on the bottom of target champion's lineage.
